title: Multithreading the Entire Destiny Engine
summary: A 2015 GDC talk by Bungie's Barry Genova on how Destiny's engine was restructured into a job graph with limited thread pre-emption. It is aimed at programmers of demanding game engines.
why: HN points to it as a real-world example of game engine multithreading and of safety annotations in C.

quote.text: explaining how Bungie turned almost every part of Destiny's engine into a job graph that can be processed in parallel
